title: OwnerRequest
description: Owner consent on the committed-yield path. A program that calls ask_owner yields this document as its committed output: the host reads it, records who owns the Session, and lets only that Person answer. The compiler stamps schema_version and schema_digest, the content address of `answer` with sorted keys, while lowering; source states neither. The next ProgramInvocationStart on the same instance carries the OwnerAnswer envelope described under $defs, which the runtime validates against `answer` before the program resumes. Neither document confers Capability authority.

OwnerAnswerSchema.description: What an answer looks like: one of the declared choices, or a value of a finite JSON type.

OwnerAnswer.description: The closed envelope an owner request resumes with, delivered as the next invocation input. An answered envelope carries the chosen choice id or a value the typed schema admits. After the deadline only declined or expired may be admitted; the runtime keeps no clock of its own.
